nodes.rationale: Loader explicitly sets table LOCATION (s3://datalake/raw/<source>/<table>/) because without it Nessie still appends a UUID to the directory name; a catalog switch alone is insufficient in the used Nessie version.

nodes.label: Airflow Pool ingest_loads (4 slots)
nodes.rationale: The pool limits the number of simultaneously running Spark applications (each is a separate driver + executors, expensive for a Docker machine) but does not allocate CPU/memory to them.

nodes.label: pg-meta — Operational Metadata DB (base meta, schema ingestion)
nodes.norm_label: pg-meta — operational metadata db (base meta, schema ingestion)
nodes.rationale: The process-id sequence cannot live in the lake (no atomic increment on object storage) and operational metadata must survive lake unavailability, so pg-meta is a dedicated Postgres instance separate from the Nessie catalog and Airflow DB.

nodes.label: e2e-testing Skill (.agents/skills/e2e-testing/SKILL.md)
nodes.rationale: Separation of concerns: sydafa's own tests cover synthetic generation and transactional semantics; for datalake_stand a 200 from /migrate plus DAG success proves the DB is up and populated, so direct SQL access to source DBs from test-runner is redundant.
